0022600182.text: The Denver Nuggets (3-3, 4th in the Northwest and 2 games back, 10th in the West) host the Toronto Raptors (4-3, 3rd in the Atlantic and 2.5 games back, 4th in the East) after Denver lost its last game and Toronto won its last. Denver is without Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (out, hamstring), and Alpha Diallo (wrist) and Cameron Johnson (lower body) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), with Jakob Poeltl (shoulder inflammation) day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, but Denver won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 121-115 in Denver on March 20, 2026.
